svg.title: Fail-Closed Sandbox Negotiation
svg.desc: Match isolation requirements against verified host backends before launching any agent subprocess — Local tests verify profile generation; production hosts require live OS qualification.
svg.text: Match isolation requirements against verified host backends before launching any agent subprocess
SANDBOX POLICY · FILESYSTEM, NETWORK & PROCESS ISOLATION
Backend Priority Order · Binary Verification · Capability Proof · Fail-Closed Guard
Refuses execution immediately when no available backend satisfies every required capability
Local tests verify profile generation; production hosts require live OS qualification.
